Soft Tacos
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 5:52pm

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef
1 tablespoon chili powder
1 cup Pace Picante Sauce
8 Mission Flour Tortillas - (8" dia)
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese

Preparation

1 Cook beef and chili powder in skillet until browned. Pour off fat. Add picante sauce and heat through. 2 Spoon about 1/4 cup meat mixture down center of each tortilla. Top with lettuce and cheese. Fold tortilla around filling. Serve with additional picante sauce. 3 This recipe yields 4 servings 4 Comments: For Chipotle Soft Tacos, substitute Pace Chipotle Chunky Salsa for Picante Sauce and omit chili powder.
